substitution.preferences_text:
This order: a 50-cover Nordic set menu, every dairy product is lactose free, no peanuts and no tree nuts.
The rules below apply to any product. Judge a substitute against the dish and the use, not against the product code.
NEVER ACCEPT:
- The original makes a dietary promise (lactose-free, gluten-free, vegan, egg-free, soy-free) and the data shows the candidate breaks it.
- A different kind of product: pork added to beef, another fruit, a cheese that is not the one named (a hard cheese instead of Parmigiano Reggiano).
- Flavoured or sweetened instead of plain: vanilla coffee milk, coffee drink, chocolate drink.
- Frozen instead of fresh.
A HUMAN DECIDES:
- The original makes a dietary promise and the candidate's data says nothing about it. Offer candidates whose data proves the promise first.
- Plant-based instead of dairy, when it serves the same use: an oat drink for drinking milk, a barista oat drink for coffee milk, a plant-based fat for butter.
- A label of the original is lost: organic, Fairtrade, MSC, Finnish or another stated origin.
- The composition changes in a way the dish would show: clearly less fat (cooking cream 15 % to 10 %, minced beef 17 % to 10 %), another type (fat-free or whole milk instead of semi-skimmed), clearly salted instead of unsalted (butter with 1.4 % salt), cheese ageing that differs by more than 6 months.
- Made for another use: cooking cream instead of whipping cream, cooking yoghurt instead of table yoghurt, drinking milk instead of coffee milk.
- Colder storage needed: a UHT or shelf-stable product replaced by a chilled one.
- The format changes how the kitchen works: a 10 l box or portion packs instead of 1 l cartons, rolls instead of a loaf, shredded instead of whole.
- Another variety of the same product: another colour of pepper, another kind of burger bun, buffalo instead of cow's milk mozzarella.
ACCEPT WITHOUT ASKING:
- Only the brand changes.
- Chilled replaced by UHT.
- A small composition change that leaves the dish the same: whipping cream 38 % to 36 %, a richer product of the same type (cooking cream 10 % to 15 %, milk 3 % to 3.5 %), lightly salted (under 1 % salt) instead of natural chicken, cheese ageing within 6 months.
- Another flavour of the same flavoured product: strawberry yoghurt to mango yoghurt.
- The same product in another case size, as long as the delivered quantity matches the order.
- Non-food: the most similar item of the same kind.
